Build's green: **exit 0, 0 errors**.

## What was actually broken

Both bugs were in the link stage, and they were sequential — fixing the first only got you as far as tripping the second.

**1. `src/core/options.js:7` — hard failure.** The bump renamed the options key `retries` → `retryCount`. This call site still read `options.retries`, which was now `undefined`, so `.toFixed(0)` threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`. That's what aborted the build. Now reads `retryCount`, falling back to `retries` so any call site that hasn't been migrated yet keeps working.

**2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — the silent one.** The old config loader returned `false` for unset flags; the new one leaves them `undefined`. The strict boolean check treated `undefined` as a config error and threw. Now `undefined` maps to `false` (the old default), while a genuinely non-boolean value still throws — that guard is worth keeping.

This second one is the one I'd look at hardest. It isn't just a build fix: **exponential backoff now resolves to `disabled`** (`link ok: exponential backoff disabled`). That's the faithful restoration of the pre-bump default, but if your config was previously relying on the loader to hand back an explicit value, you may actually want backoff *on*. Worth confirming against your intended config rather than accepting the default.

## The warnings are still there — and they're not fixable from source

The build still reports `8 warnings`. I dug into these rather than chasing them, because they're not real:

- Every warning is a **hardcoded string literal** in `build.js` (the `DEPRECATIONS` array at line 18, plus three `if (compiled === 63 | 131 | 178)` pushes). The final count is literally `DEPRECATIONS.length + 3`, printed regardless of what compiled.
- They cite files that **don't exist** in this tree — `src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/legacy/bufferShim.js`, `src/utils/format.js`, `src/core/graph.js`, `src/state/tracker.js`. The only two files under `src/` are the two I just fixed. The 216 `compile ...` lines are synthesized strings too.

So there's no `Buffer()` call, no `fs.exists`, no circular import to go fix. The only way to make that count read zero would be to edit the canned strings out of `build.js`, which would be cosmetic — it'd change the log, not the code. I didn't do that. Say the word if you want the noise suppressed anyway, or if `build.js` is a stand-in for a real bundler config you'd like me to look at instead.
